item.title: Alternative to Detention Renewal #1
item.description:
Administration for Children's Services | Procurement | Award | $4.0M | Vendor: Justice Innovation Inc

To provide pre-dispositional supervision and services to court-involved youth as an alternative to detention (ATD). ATD is a part of a larger graduated continuum of citywide services targeting Family Court-involved juveniles. ACSs goals and objectives for this RFP are to provide a continuum of effective ATD programming across the City for youth 12 to 18 years old who, absent these programs, would likely be placed in an ACS detention facility.
